screens.name: Home
screens.visual_hierarchy: Lead with Editorial hero; sequence Trust proof → Collections → Featured products → Manufacturing story → Workshop/artisans → Purity/packaging → Reviews → Wholesale/custom → Journal/FAQ → Footer. One dominant action and restrained evidence-led supporting actions.
screens.grid: Mobile 4 columns/16px gutter; tablet 8/24px; desktop 12/32px; max 1440px; editorial reading measure 720px.
screens.spacing: Use 4px base; 24–32px component groups, 48–80px sections mobile/tablet, 80–128px desktop editorial sections; density reduces only in dealer/CMS operational regions.
screens.typography: One display/H1; serif display for editorial titles only; sans body/UI; 16px minimum body; tabular numerals for price/metrics; responsive clamp without line or layout clipping.
screens.color_usage: Gallery Ivory canvas, Brand Ink text, white raised surfaces, silver borders/details, vermilion one-primary-accent maximum, semantic colors for states; decorative gold never conveys status.
screens.motion: 160ms controls, 240ms navigation/layout, ≤420ms editorial reveal; transform/opacity only; reduced-motion static equivalent; no essential autoplay.
screens.cta_hierarchy: Primary filled ink or inverse high-contrast button; secondary outline/text; destructive separated and confirmed; dealer/admin high-risk actions use explicit labels.
screens.responsive_rules: Mobile source order is canonical; tablet composes paired regions; desktop may split editorial/task columns. Sticky regions disable when viewport/zoom cannot fit. No hover-only information.
screens.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA; logical landmarks/headings/focus; 44px targets; keyboard/screen-reader complete; 3:1 focus; 4.5:1 normal text; 200% zoom; state not color-only; reduced motion.
seo_placeholders: Breadcrumb/schema placeholder when public and eligible
cms_editable_zones: Transactional, price, stock, identity and ERP-derived facts are not freeform CMS fields
screens.dark_mode: Map semantic surfaces/text/borders; protect product color accuracy; no image inversion; use charcoal not pure black; revalidate all contrast and media overlays.
screens.performance: Reserve media dimensions; prioritize only true LCP; responsive AVIF/WebP/JPEG; lazy-load below fold; poster-gate video/social; no visual dependency required for comprehension.

screens.responsive_rules: Mobile source order is canonical; tablet composes paired regions; desktop may split editorial/task columns. Sticky regions disable when viewport/zoom cannot fit. No hover-only information.
screens.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA; logical landmarks/headings/focus; 44px targets; keyboard/screen-reader complete; 3:1 focus; 4.5:1 normal text; 200% zoom; state not color-only; reduced motion.
seo_placeholders: Breadcrumb/schema placeholder when public and eligible
cms_editable_zones: Transactional, price, stock, identity and ERP-derived facts are not freeform CMS fields
screens.dark_mode: Map semantic surfaces/text/borders; protect product color accuracy; no image inversion; use charcoal not pure black; revalidate all contrast and media overlays.
screens.performance: Reserve media dimensions; prioritize only true LCP; responsive AVIF/WebP/JPEG; lazy-load below fold; poster-gate video/social; no visual dependency required for comprehension.
